items.question: What is the first kūṭa of the mantra when śakti is divided?
premises: śaktibhinnaṃ names the divided power
bindunādakalāḍhyaṃ describes its fullness
vāgbhavaṃ tu idam identifies this kūṭa
items.inference: The vāgbhava kūṭa is the śakti-divided form rich in bindu, nāda, and kalā.
uncertainties: exact sandhi of bindunādakalāḍhyaṃ not expanded
items.plain_english: This vāgbhava kūṭa is divided by śakti and rich in bindu, nāda, and kalā.

items.question: What is the second kūṭa when bindu, nāda, and kalā pervade it?
premises: bindunādakalākrāntaṃ marks pervasion
kāmarājam idaṃ mahat names the great kūṭa
items.inference: The kāmarāja kūṭa is the great form pervaded by bindu, nāda, and kalā.
uncertainties: gender agreement of mahat with kāmarājam not resolved
items.plain_english: This great kāmarāja kūṭa is pervaded by bindu, nāda, and kalā.

items.question: How is protection accomplished with the arrow mantra?
premises: anena śaramantreṇa names the means
rakṣaṇaṃ states the aim
kavacena tu adds armor
items.inference: Protection is done by the arrow mantra and armor.
uncertainties: exact relation of kavacena to rakṣaṇaṃ not specified
items.plain_english: By this arrow mantra, protection is made with armor.

items.question: What mudrā action is performed over Madana?
premises: baddhvā triśūlamudrāntu tu names the bound mudrā
bhrāmayet states revolving
madanopari gives the location
items.inference: One binds the trident mudrā and revolves it over Madana.
uncertainties: whether baddhvā modifies mudrā or practitioner
items.plain_english: Having bound the trident mudrā, one revolves it over Madana.

items.question: What is declared about the trident mudrā?
premises: prasārayet states extension
triśūlasya mudreyaṃ iyam names the mudrā
parikīrttitā marks declaration
items.inference: This trident mudrā is declared by extending it.
uncertainties: exact syntactic role of mudreyaṃ
items.plain_english: This trident mudrā is declared by extending it.

items.question: How are the weapon mantra and heart used?
premises: uddhared astramantreṇa states raising by weapon mantra
hṛdayena vilopayet states removing by heart
items.inference: One raises with the weapon mantra and removes with the heart.
uncertainties: object of uddhared and vilopayet not stated
items.plain_english: Raise with the weapon mantra and remove with the heart.

items.question: When is daily worship established by mantra?
premises: nityapūjāṃ vidhāya eva states daily worship performed
niśi saṃsthāpya vidyayā states establishment at night by mantra
items.inference: Daily worship is performed and established at night by mantra.
uncertainties: whether vidyayā modifies saṃsthāpya only
items.plain_english: Having performed daily worship, establish it at night by mantra.

items.question: What alternative consecration serves yearly worship fulfillment?
premises: sadyo'dhivāsanaṃ vā api gives immediate consecration alternative
varṣapūjārthasiddhaye states purpose
items.inference: Immediate consecration also serves fulfillment of yearly worship purpose.
uncertainties: whether sadyaḥ is adverb or compound member
items.plain_english: Or immediate consecration also, for fulfillment of yearly worship purpose.

items.question: What diagram is made with vermilion?
premises: navakoṇaṃ vidhāya atha states making nine-cornered
sindūreṇa mahāprabham states with vermilion radiant
items.inference: A nine-cornered, greatly radiant diagram is made with vermilion.
uncertainties: whether mahāprabham modifies diagram or sindūra
items.plain_english: Then make a nine-cornered, greatly radiant diagram with vermilion.

items.question: What may the best teacher place?
premises: ekaṃ vā sakalaṃ ramyaṃ gives options
sthāpayed deśikottamaḥ states placement by best teacher
items.inference: The best teacher may place one or the whole pleasing form.
uncertainties: exact object of sthāpayed
items.plain_english: The best teacher should place one or the whole pleasing form.

items.question: What diagram is drawn after the aśoka tree?
premises: aśokatarum ālikhya states drawing aśoka tree
trikoṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ likhet states drawing three-cornered diagram
items.inference: After drawing the aśoka tree, one draws a three-cornered diagram.
uncertainties: whether ālikhya and likhet are sequential or alternative
items.plain_english: Having drawn the aśoka tree, draw a three-cornered diagram.

items.question: What red items are placed left and right in order?
premises: raktapuṣpaṃ raktavastraṃ names red items
vāmadakṣiṇayoḥ kramāt states left and right in order
items.inference: Red flower and red cloth are placed left and right in order.
uncertainties: whether both items are paired to both sides
items.plain_english: Red flower and red cloth are placed left and right in order.

items.question: Why is Kāma worshipped with spring?
premises: vasantasahitaṃ kāmaṃ pūjayet states worship of Kāma with spring
siddhihetave states purpose
items.inference: Kāma is worshipped with spring for accomplishment.
uncertainties: whether vasanta is attendant or season
items.plain_english: Worship Kāma with spring for accomplishment.

items.question: What is the nine-syllabled mantra for Kāma?
premises: kāmāya nama gives salutation
alikhya vidyeyantu iyam tu navākṣarī identifies the mantra
items.inference: The nine-syllabled mantra is written with salutation to Kāma.
uncertainties: surface alikhya vs ālikhya not normalized
items.plain_english: Write the nine-syllabled mantra: salutation to Kāma.

items.question: What is declared as the eight-lettered Rati mantra?
premises: ratyai namaś ca gives salutation
aṣṭavarṇā ratividyā prakīrttitā declares the mantra
items.inference: The eight-lettered Rati mantra is declared with salutation to Rati.
uncertainties: ca placement
items.plain_english: And salutation to Rati; the eight-lettered Rati mantra is declared.

items.question: What mantra replaces Rati in its place?
premises: prītiṃ vadet ratisthāne states saying delight in Rati's place
prītimantro 'ṣṭavarṇakaḥ names eight-lettered delight mantra
items.inference: In Rati's place one says delight, using the eight-lettered delight mantra.
uncertainties: whether prītiṃ is object of vadet
items.plain_english: In Rati's place say delight; the delight mantra is eight-lettered.

items.question: How is the deity adorned and handed?
premises: padmatāmbūlahaste states lotus and betel in hand
raktavarṇavibhūṣite states red-colored adorned
items.inference: The deity is adorned in red and holds lotus and betel.
uncertainties: whether ca connects to previous verse
items.plain_english: With lotus and betel in hand, adorned in red color.

items.question: What meditation of Kāmadeva is declared?
premises: vāmadakṣiṇayor states left and right
dhyānaṃ kāmadevasya kīrttitam declares meditation
items.inference: The meditation of Kāmadeva is declared for left and right.
uncertainties: whether vāmadakṣiṇayor modifies dhyānaṃ or placement
items.plain_english: The meditation of Kāmadeva is declared for left and right.

items.question: What golden object is held in the left hand?
premises: sauvarṇaṃ vāmahaste ca states golden in left hand
sudhāpūrṇaghaṭānvitam states with nectar-filled pot
items.inference: A golden object with a nectar-filled pot is held in the left hand.
uncertainties: whether sauvarṇaṃ modifies ghaṭa
items.plain_english: Golden, with a nectar-filled pot in the left hand.

items.question: What is shown after worshipping Kāma with limbs?
premises: sāṅgaṃ kāmaṃ prapūjyātha states worshipping Kāma with limbs
atha dhūpadīpādi darśayet states showing incense lamp etc
items.inference: After worshipping Kāma with limbs, one shows incense, lamp, and so on.
uncertainties: whether prapūjyātha includes atha
items.plain_english: Having worshipped Kāma with limbs, then show incense, lamp, and so on.

items.question: What is worshipped properly before Mahātripurasundarī?
premises: tañ ca samyak prapūjyātha states properly worshipping that
atha mahātripurasundarīm states then Mahātripurasundarī
items.inference: That is properly worshipped, then Mahātripurasundarī.
uncertainties: referent of tañ not stated
items.plain_english: Having properly worshipped that, then worship Mahātripurasundarī.

items.question: What offerings accompany the worship?
premises: saugandhikaiḥ sakāśmīrair nānāphalarasair api lists offerings
items.inference: Fragrant flowers, saffron, and various fruit juices are also offered.
uncertainties: whether these modify pūjā or arccana
items.plain_english: With fragrant flowers, saffron, and various fruit juices also.

items.question: What is worshipped after honoring a married woman?
premises: suvāsinīñ ca saṃpūjya states honoring married woman
yonimaṇḍalam arccayet states worshipping yoni diagram
items.inference: After honoring a married woman, one worships the yoni diagram.
uncertainties: whether suvāsinīñ is object of saṃpūjya
items.plain_english: Having honored a married woman, worship the yoni diagram.

items.question: What is given after honoring brahmins?
premises: brāhmaṇān api saṃpūjya states honoring brahmins
pradadyād gurudakṣiṇām states giving teacher offering
items.inference: After honoring brahmins, one gives the teacher offering.
uncertainties: whether gurudakṣiṇām is fee or gift
items.plain_english: Having honored brahmins, give the teacher offering.
